requirement: Make Start Over work safely for as many built-in games as possible, and automatically embed/reset games added through the plus button, then publish a fresh shareable extension.

architecture.decision: Represent resets as explicit reload-only, selected-key, or clear-all strategies. Built-in games use the narrowest verified strategy; user-added games use clear-all for their own origin. Register custom hostnames with one tightly scoped dynamic declarativeNetRequest rule limited to Puzzle Date subframes.
seams: Built-in resets must preserve tutorials and lifetime statistics whenever a verified selected-key or reload-only strategy is available.
Custom-domain iframe rules must remain limited to user-added hostnames, Puzzle Date/localhost initiators, sub_frame resources, and the three approved framing headers.
Reset execution must target only the visible active iframe and never a hidden preloaded frame.

tasks.title: Audit built-in reset strategies
tasks.intent: Inspect public game source assets and existing behavior to identify the narrowest reliable Start Over strategy for each built-in game without reading browser storage or changing live game progress.
tasks.constraints: Do not inspect browser cookies or local/session storage. Use public source/assets and existing user-provided key evidence. Distinguish verified keys from reload-only or unsafe unknowns.
tasks.acceptance: Every built-in game has a documented strategy recommendation, evidence, and preservation risk; unsupported cases are explicitly identified.
tasks.result: Audited all 11 built-ins from public assets and user evidence; verified narrow resets for Word 500, FoxiMax, Verticle, 4×3, Full Circle Friday, and Poople, and documented five unsafe/unsupported games.

tasks.title: Implement reset strategy protocol
tasks.intent: Add an explicit app-to-extension reset protocol and enable Start Over for every built-in game whose audited strategy is safe and reliable.
tasks.constraints: Built-in resets must preserve tutorials and lifetime statistics whenever a verified selected-key or reload-only strategy is available. Reset execution must target only the visible active iframe and never a hidden preloaded frame.
tasks.acceptance: The app sends a typed reset strategy; the extension validates it; safe built-in games expose Start Over and execute the intended reload/key removal/clear behavior without broadening reset scope.
tasks.verify: npm run build:pages && node --check chrome-extension/background.js && node --check chrome-extension/content.js
tasks.visual: Use real Chrome to verify representative reload-only, selected-key, and clear-all reset paths and confirm hidden preload frames are not targeted.
tasks.result: Replaced loose key transport with double-validated strategy IDs and implemented exact narrow resets for six audited built-ins, including origin binding, transactional Verticle updates, and preserved Poople modal handling; build and syntax checks passed.

tasks.title: Register custom games automatically
tasks.intent: Make every valid plus-button game request extension-backed embedding for its hostname and receive a generic clear-all Start Over action, including games restored from Puzzle Date storage.
tasks.constraints: Custom-domain iframe rules must remain limited to user-added hostnames, Puzzle Date/localhost initiators, sub_frame resources, and the three approved framing headers. Validate protocols and hostnames at both app and extension boundaries.
tasks.acceptance: Adding or restoring a custom HTTPS/HTTP game registers only its hostname, embeds it with the extension, shows Start Over, and clears only that iframe origin's local storage before reloading.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && npm run build:pages
tasks.visual: Add a controlled test game in Chrome, verify it embeds, confirm Start Over is present, and verify invalid/non-web URLs remain rejected.
tasks.result: Implemented acknowledged custom-host registration with one tightly scoped dynamic DNR rule, custom iframe fallback/rekeying, and hostname-bound localStorage-only Start Over for new/restored plus-button games; build, syntax, validator, and diff checks passed.

tasks.title: Package test and publish extension
tasks.intent: Bump, sync, reproducibly package, and test the enhanced extension and app, publish both release branches, and verify the live app, guide, and fresh extension link.
tasks.constraints: Do not stage dependencies, build directories, or unrelated main-workspace changes. Deploy only the exact Chrome-tested source state.
tasks.acceptance: Real Chrome tests pass, the stable local extension and public ZIP match the bumped release, GitHub Pages succeeds, and the downloadable link serves the new version.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:pages && unzip -t public/downloads/puzzle-date-game-reset.zip
tasks.visual: Test built-in and custom game flows with the reloaded release extension, then verify the deployed app and installation guide.
tasks.result: Released extension 1.0.6 after real Chrome verification of custom hostname registration, automatic iframe embedding, custom-origin localStorage clearing, Poople reset/modal behavior, and Verticle reset. Published commit b2cdfd2 to main; GitHub Pages serves the matching 1.0.6 ZIP (SHA-256 ef52d02ce60141edf17b07c6bd89db778ca9c2c72149e3ec2857626fe87531c8).
